known_limits: Full-sentence native search remains weak; data delivery is not a validated natural-language QA product. Use concepts/keywords and inspect conditions/source evidence.
Vector baseline not implemented; fusion is offline evaluation only, no software feature added.
240 model-reviewed development cases are not an independent/human gold test. Precision is a lower bound against annotated passages; unannotated results are not automatically irrelevant.
No generated-answer faithfulness, human semantic score, conflict detection rate, adversarial score, visual interaction, ablation or generalization claim.
265 figure origins remain unverified and 263 are later annotations; viewing does not establish author identity.
473 reviewed claims retain explicit ambiguity, 2611 candidates remain excluded from default knowledge. Unresolved interpretation is not silently fixed.
9138 historical lesson-row hashes match current text; 167 legacy rows lack historical text hashes but contain per-passage dispositions. No fabricated historical hashes.
Software deliverables and desktop UI/build/package acceptance are excluded by the direct user scope.
